To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the ESD performance of the nLDMOS with discrete n+ islands is improved by 4.9% and the ESD reliability of the nLMO-SCR with discrete n+ source islands is upgraded by 24.7% as compared with those without discrete islands.
source-end discrete islands can effectively enhance ESD reliability of nLDMOS transistors.
the source-end discrete islands of the HV nLDMOS can be effectively used for ESD enhancement.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and failure analysis of nLDMOS ESD enhancement.
ESD enhancement of nLDMOS with discrete islands in the source-end region.
the ESD immunity enhancement of HV nLDMOS transistors with discrete n+ islands.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
source-end design is a good choice for ESD enhancement in nLDMOS transistors.
the source-end discrete islands and the drain-end SCR with npn (p+npn, pnp) stripe manner can be effectively used in the design of ESD enhancement for the nLDMOS.
the nLDMOS with source end n+ discrete islands and drain end npn- (pnp-) arranged nLDMOS SCR is a better candidate to achieve the best ESD robustness.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the nLDMOS can be effectively improved by the source-end design, while the drain-end design is more efficient.

the nLDMOS can be effectively improved by the discrete n+ islands, the SCR with npn (p+ p+) stripe manner in the source (drain) end, and the SCR with npnp (ppnp) stripe manner at both source and drain ends.
an ESD-protected nLDMOS with discrete islands can achieve a better It2 value than that with a pnp-arranged nLDMOS SCR.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ESD capability of an nL DMOS can be effectively enhanced by designing the discrete islands in the source region and by arranging npn or pnp stripes in the drain region.
discrete n+ islands formed at the source end of a DUT are effective in enhancing the ESD capability of the DUT.
the discrete n+ islands formed in the source region are very important to the enhancement of ESD capability.
